newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya's exiled Moslem preacher returns home.
newsitem.headline: Kenya's exiled Moslem preacher returns home.

text.p: Sheikh Khalid Balala, a Moslem preacher and leading critic of Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi, returned home on Saturday after two years of forced exile in Germany.

Airport officials of the Lufthansa German airline told Reuters by telephone that Balala, whose return is a boost for Kenya's opposition now battling Moi for constitutional reforms, landed at Nairobi international airport at 1755 GMT.
"Sheikh Balala has arrived. He arrived on our (Lufthansa) scheduled flight which landed at exactly 8.55 p.m. (1755 GMT)," a Lufthansa official in the airport's information office told Reuters.
Balala's return came a week after Moi dramatically reversed his earlier stand not to allow the fiery preacher back home after accusing him of being a Yemeni.

He also returns at a time of heightened political tension in the east African country where nine people died this week in political unrest over demands for constitutional reforms Moi has refused to enact.
